title: Harbour bridge maintenance plan 2026
summary: Schedules cable inspections each quarter and a full repaint of the north span in September 2026; the budget is 4.2 million.

title: Harbour bridge cable inspection report Q2
summary: Found corrosion on 3 of 96 suspension cables; recommends replacing them before winter and moving inspections to monthly.

title: City library refurbishment business case
summary: Proposes a 1.8 million refurbishment adding study rooms and solar panels, with payback on energy savings in 11 years.

title: Stormwater upgrade risk register
summary: Lists flooding of the eastern catchment as the top risk; mitigation is the new 2.5 km culvert due in March 2027.

title: Bus fleet electrification roadmap
summary: Replaces 120 diesel buses with electric ones by 2030; the first 20 arrive in 2027 with two new charging depots.

title: Bus depot charging capacity study
summary: Each depot needs a 2.4 MW grid connection; the utility quotes 14 months lead time for the upgrade.

title: Parks irrigation water use 2025-26
summary: Recycled water now covers 64 percent of park irrigation, up from 41 percent, saving 310 megalitres of drinking water.

title: Cyber incident tabletop exercise findings
summary: Recovery of the rates system took 19 hours against a 6 hour target; backups were sound but restore runbooks were out of date.
